new_defects.title: pushInsteadOf is claimed as a proven D2 key in charter/DONE but no test case exists for it
new_defects.evidence: execution-safety.test.ts:465 covers exactly two configurations ("file:// rewrite", "plain path rewrite"); grep -rn pushInsteadOf src/ returns 0 hits and the only repository occurrence is charter/DONE/mg-s1b-git-env-hardening.md:14, which lists url.*.pushInsteadOf under proof 3 with mutant "remove one key from the list -> RED, for every key". Behaviour measured in chqa/evidence-d1-mechanism.txt: pushInsteadOf does not affect git remote get-url or ls-remote (contactRemote is not exploitable through it today) and no git push argv exists in src/, but the same checked URL is redirected on a push (push --dry-run exit 0). Not a bypass of the D1 fix: contactRemote still contacts exactly the checked URL. Source: /Users/bradleyheitmann/.local/share/agent-private/mister-clean/master-gate/s1b/chqa/receipt.json.
